item.title: OptQC and NTT Sign Capital Alliance to Build 1-Million-Qubit Optical Quantum Computer
item.summary: Tokyo-based optical quantum startup OptQC Corp. and telecommunications giant NTT, Inc. have signed a capital and business alliance agreement to accelerate the development and commercialization of a fault-tolerant, 1-million-qubit-class optical quantum computer. Under the agreement, NTT will make a strategic equity investment in OptQC to establish a medium- to long-term collaborative framework spanning hardware architecture [...] The post OptQC and NTT Sign Capital Alliance to Build 1-Million-Qubit Optical Quantum Computer appeared first on Quantum Computing Report .
